title: Sukh Dutt Ratra v. State of Himachal Pradesh

content.caseIdentity: Sukh Dutt Ratra v. State of Himachal Pradesh, (2022) 7 SCC 508
content.holding: Reaffirmed Vidya Devi; held that the State cannot act as a trespasser and must pay solatium and interest for historical de facto land acquisitions.
content.relevance: Confirmation of state liability for uncompensated land seizures.
